desc:
Current Episodes: 2

A liminal themed horror game with exploration, puzzles, secrets, and entities. After being on the brink of insanity due to being unable to dream for so long, you seek assistance in the form of medicine. Your dreams are now more vivid than ever but you must find a way to wake up before they consume you.

**Inspired by Interliminality and Apeirophobia.**

Join the group: https://www.roblox.com/communities/15487424/Pancake-Studio#!/about

For best experience🕹️
Play with max graphics
Wear headphones

This game contains flashing lights and jumpscares and may not function as intended on low-end devices

Play with up to 6 of your friends with Mobile, Console, and PC support!

TAGS: Liminal, Horror, Scary
